We ran into an issue this week where the chat support agents wanted to be able to see all available QuickText items in a list rather than in the quicktext shortcut (";;") menu. After some digging, we found a pretty elegant solution directly from Salesforce Product Management:

Live Agent Quick Text in Service Cloud Cons

Code from the link:

function sendTextToInput(message) {
 var sendMessage = message;
 sforce.console.getFocusedPrimaryTabId( function(result) {
 sforce.console.chat.getDetailsByPrimaryTabId(result.id, function(result2) {
 sforce.console.chat.setAgentInput(result2.details.chatKey, sendMessage);
 });
 });
}

We ended up doing a custom console component rather than a pinned tab, but the effect is more or less the same.

 

However, we did run into another issue. It seems that the console integration toolkit doesn't support merge fields from quick text (e.g. "Please wait a moment while I look up this information. May we contact you at 1234567890?" would actually show up as "Please wait a moment while I look up this information. May we contact you at {!Case_SuppliedPhone}?"). These fields work as expected from the QT shortcut menu, so we're not sure what magic is being processed on the back-end there.

I've tossed this issue out to Stack Exchange looking for potential solutions. If anyone here has a suggestion feel free to throw it out there. I'll update the thread if we ever find a fix :)

 

TL;DR - The Console Integration Toolkit seems to be ignoring merge fields from Quick Text records. Will post workaround / solution upon discovery.
